findings.text: blocking: the measured live second payload pass is 26.419 s against the brief's under-5-s done-when, and that measurement ran at 19c6b87e9102 rather than the final reviewed head.

blocking: the new signature takes indexed entry identities without revalidating the files, so a same-path in-place rewrite leaves the memo key unchanged and reckon/crew/obligations.py:1379 can serve a stale review where the prior selector revalidated it; the added test only appends a record.

item_verdicts.diff: four commits from 51d53c06ac2c7db73707ba00e872c648697d4a5d to 4058ef42efd9dfec66242df59e74d9227ab45191 change six declared files, adding per-run review keys, a shared key memo, a held-tree check, tests and timing evidence.
item_verdicts.done_when: the source brief.md requires a live second pass under 5 s; docs/research/monitor-storage-load-rca.html:387 records 26.419 s at the first implementation commit, while logs/armed-head-repair.log records three tests passed at the reviewed head.
item_verdicts.goal: the source brief.md asks for indexed per-run review reads and an unchanged verdict; reckon/crew/obligations.py:1368 adds the memo but the live timing and record-rewrite behavior leave the full goal unmet.
item_verdicts.manifest: the source manifest.md records the four commits, base/head gate logs, 15 passing importer tests per arm, and the 26.419 s live result above its bound.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the source manifest.md grants the four Python paths and two document paths shown by the diff, and all six changed paths are inside that list.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_review_duty_reads_its_run_review_once.py:202-239 fails at base when unchanged reads recur or the new run is not selected, but it never changes an existing indexed review file in place.
justifications.evidence: logs/negative-control-repair.log fails all three focused cases at base and logs/armed-head-repair.log passes them at head, while docs/research/monitor-storage-load-rca.html:387 measures only the earlier implementation commit at 26.419 s.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/obligations.py:1379 uses the existing file_memo cache idiom and reckon/crew/review_records.py:1427 extends the index owner, with no new forbidden source name.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/obligations.py:1368 memoises a run's review selection, but docs/research/monitor-storage-load-rca.html:390 records a second pass above the required bound.
justifications.reuse: the capability search found reckon/file_memo.py:358 as the bounded memo owner and reckon/crew/review_records.py:1318 as the store-index owner, and the additions extend those owners rather than copy them.
justifications.scope_discipline: the six paths in the 51d53c06ac2c7db73707ba00e872c648697d4a5d..4058ef42efd9dfec66242df59e74d9227ab45191 diff all occur in the source manifest.md write_paths list.
